'''Rena Nounen''' (Japanese: '''能年 玲奈''' ''Nōnen Rena''),<ref name="Lespros"/> known professionally as '''Non''' (のん ''Non''), is a Japanese actress, model, and singer. She is best known for her lead role on the 2013 drama series ''{{wp|Amachan}}''.<ref name="Amachan"/> She released her debut single, Ohirome Pack in 2017,<ref name="OhiromePack"/> and released her debut album, Superhero's, in 2018.<ref name="SuperHeroes"/> She voiced the protagonist [[Haru]] in the Japanese version of ''[[Pokémon Concierge]]''<ref name="Haru"/> and performed the song [[GwGw]] for the [[Pokémon Music Collective]] project.<ref name="GwGw"/>

==Biography==
Non was born Rena Nounen on July 13, 1993 in Hyōgo Prefecture.<ref name="Lespros">[https://web.archive.org/web/20171030164942/http://lespros.co.jp/talent/artists/rena_nounen/ 能年玲奈 | アーティスト | レプロエンタテインメント (archived)<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref><ref name="top-profile>[https://nondesu.jp/#top__profile TOP PROFILE - のん 公式サイト<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> She made her modelling debut in 2006 and her acting debut in 2010.<ref name="Lespros"/> She got her first leading role for the {{wp|NHK}} drama series {{jwp|あまちゃん}} ''{{wp|Amachan}}'' in 2013.<ref name="Amachan"/> In 2017 she launched her own record label called KAIWA（RE）CORD and began releasing music as a solo artist,<ref>[https://www.oricon.co.jp/news/2095096/full/ のん、本格的音楽活動を開始 新レーベル発足し「楽しんで参りたい」 | オリコンニュース（ORICON NEWS）<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> debuting with single Ohirome Pack in 2017<ref name="OhiromePack">[https://nondesu.jp/2668/ のん『オヒロメ・パック』10/4より主要音楽ストアにて配信開始です。 - のん 公式サイト<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> and her first album called Superhero's in 2018.<ref name="SuperHeroes">[https://nondesu.jp/3594/ 5/9 1stアルバム「スーパーヒーローズ」発売！発売前日&個展最終日の5/8には1st ワンマンの開催も決定いたしました！ - のん 公式サイト<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

In 2023, she provided the Japanese voice of [[Haru]] in the [[Netflix]] stop-motion animated series ''[[Pokémon Concierge]]''.<ref name="Haru"/> She was featured in a behind-the-scenes set visit video about the making of ''Pokémon Concierge''.<ref>[https://about.netflix.com/en/news/netflixanimeexpo2023#:~:text=POK%C3%89MON%20CONCIERGE,-%2D%20December%2C%202023 Netflix Celebrates Japanese Content Slate at Anime Expo 2023 - About Netflix<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> In 2025, she released the song [[GwGw]]{{#tag:ref|pronounced {{j|ぐわぐわ}} ''guwa-guwa''<ref>{{tt|のん: あ、タイトルGwGwの読み方はぐわぐわ。|Non: Oh, the title GwGw is pronounced guwa-guwa.}} ([https://sp.kanaboon.jp/news/detail/2614#:~:text=あ、タイトルGwGwの読み方はぐわぐわ。 「Pokémon Music Collective」楽曲、のんニューシングル「GwGw」本日配信開始！ KANA-BOONがプロデュース！<!-- Bot generated title -->])</ref>|group=note}} produced by {{wp|KANA-BOON}} for the [[Pokémon Music Collective]] collaboration project. <ref name="GwGw"/>
